title: Dotman v0.2.0 - Stability & Extensibility
description: Improve dotman with circular dependency detection, CLI integration tests, hooks system, and rollback capability

title: US-007: Fix lint warning - unused variable
description: Fix unused variable warning in test_template_rendering_in_directories.py line 83 so ruff check returns 0 errors.

title: US-009: Phase 2 - Template-rendered hooks
description: Extend hooks to support Jinja2 template syntax. Hooks access global/local/package variables. Add package_name, dotfiles_dir, target_dir as special variables.

title: US-010: Add rollback capability
description: Add deployment history tracking in .dotman/history.yaml. Create dotman rollback command. Support --dry-run for preview. Restore from backup directory and remove created symlinks.

title: Update README documentation for v0.2.0 features
description: Update README.md with: circular dependency detection docs, hooks system documentation with examples, rollback command documentation, updated command reference.

title: US-xxx: Inject special variables into template file rendering
description:
As a dotman user, I want template files to have access to special variables like {{package_name}}, {{dotfiles_dir}}, and {{target_dir}} so that I can use them in my templates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Template files can use {{package_name}} to get the current package name
- [ ] Template files can use {{dotfiles_dir}} to get the dotfiles repository path
- [ ] Template files can use {{target_dir}} to get the target directory path
- [ ] These variables are automatically available without defining them in config
- [ ] ruff check passes
- [ ] ruff format passes
- [ ] mypy passes
- [ ] pytest passes

title: US-011: Clean build artifacts for mypy
description: Remove build/ from mypy tracking, add .mypy_cache/ to .gitignore, ensure mypy runs without duplicate module errors.

title: US-001: Detect and report circular dependencies
description: Replace recursive dependency validation with iterative algorithm. Detect cycles like A→B→C→A and self-references. Raise clear error message with cycle path.

title: US-002: Add CLI integration tests for deploy command
description: Add integration tests for: no packages, specific package, --dry-run, --force, missing source, circular dependency. Tests should verify deploy command behavior.

title: US-003: Add CLI integration tests for undeploy command
description: Add integration tests for: no packages, specific package, --dry-run, removes symlinks, skips non-symlinks, circular dependency.

title: US-004: Add CLI integration tests for status command
description: Add integration tests for: no packages, specific package, LINKED/MISSING/BROKEN/CONFLICT statuses, template file handling.

title: US-005: Add CLI integration tests for init command
description: Add integration tests for: creates .dotman directory, creates config.yaml, creates local.yaml, doesn't overwrite existing, shows already-initialized message.

title: US-006: Add CLI integration tests for list and absorb commands
description: Add integration tests for: list shows packages with enabled status, correct file count, dependencies. Absorb: --dry-run, skips symlinks/templates, respects absorb_ignore patterns.

title: US-008: Phase 1 - Basic shell command hooks
description: Add hooks field to config schema. Support pre_deploy and post_deploy hooks. Execute shell commands via subprocess. Dry-run mode doesn't execute hooks.

title: Integrate hooks into dotman CLI deploy command
description: Currently the hooks functionality (pre_deploy and post_deploy) is fully implemented but not wired into the deploy command. This epic adds hook execution to the CLI so users can run shell commands before/after package deployment.

title: US-001: Add HookExecutor import and initialization in deploy command
description:
As a dotman user, I want hooks to run during deployment so that my shell commands execute automatically.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Import HookExecutor from dotman.hook_executor in cli.py
- [ ] Create HookExecutor instance in the deploy command with dry_run parameter
- [ ] HookExecutor is created alongside LinkManager, TemplateEngine, and HistoryManager
- [ ] ruff check passes
- [ ] ruff format passes
- [ ] mypy passes
- [ ] pytest passes

title: US-002: Execute pre_deploy hooks before file deployment
description:
As a dotman user, I want pre_deploy hooks to run before my files are deployed so that I can prepare the environment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For each package, execute pre_deploy hooks before processing files
- [ ] Pass package variables, dotfiles_dir, and target_dir to hook executor
- [ ] Display hook commands being executed in console output
- [ ] Abort deployment if pre_deploy hook fails (stop processing this package)
- [ ] ruff check passes
- [ ] ruff format passes
- [ ] mypy passes
- [ ] pytest passes

title: US-003: Execute post_deploy hooks after file deployment
description:
As a dotman user, I want post_deploy hooks to run after my files are deployed so that I can complete setup tasks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For each package, execute post_deploy hooks after processing all files
- [ ] Pass package variables, dotfiles_dir, and target_dir to hook executor
- [ ] Display hook commands being executed in console output
- [ ] Continue deployment even if post_deploy hook fails (log error but don't abort)
- [ ] ruff check passes
- [ ] ruff format passes
- [ ] mypy passes
- [ ] pytest passes
